children: Oracle announced that Larry Ellison has cancelled his 10b5-1 plan to sell Oracle stock and no shares were sold under the plan.
Larry Ellison cancelled his 10b5-1 plan to sell Oracle stock on Sept. 12, 2026.
No Oracle shares were sold under the cancelled plan prior to termination.
Ellison stated he has no other plans to sell any of his Oracle stock.
The announcement was made via a press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K.
